subject.title: Centralize chat-session naming; define subagent session lifetime & cross-channel persistence

question: What should be the canonical core contract for naming and retaining ACP/subagent-created sessions, and how should it relate to existing identityLinks and session-retention work?
rationale: The issue chooses persisted session metadata, possible model-call title generation, ACP/subagent cleanup semantics, and cross-channel identity sharing, which cannot be safely resolved as a narrow automated bug fix.

options.title: Define Core Contract First
options.body: Keep this as the design umbrella, choose the naming/lifetime/persistence contract, and split implementation into title, lifecycle, and identity follow-up PRs.

options.title: Ship Naming Separately
options.body: Handle central title projection first while leaving ACP/subagent lifetime and cross-channel persistence to existing lifecycle and identity trackers.

options.title: Document Current Behavior Only
options.body: Clarify the existing dashboard title, subagent archive, ACP binding, and identityLinks behavior without adding new persistence semantics yet.

recommendation.title: Define Core Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this as the design umbrella, choose the naming/lifetime/persistence contract, and split implementation into title, lifecycle, and identity follow-up PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses session-list behavior, ACP/subagent lifecycle, config/security boundaries, and related maintainer discussion where this handle has the strongest adjacent history signal.
